name: Dragomon
main_effect:
＜Jamming＞ (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By trashing 1 of your Digimon's link cards, you may play or use 1 [TS] trait card with a play or use cost of 5 or less from your hand without paying the cost.
source_effect: [All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, by trashing 1 of its link cards, it doesn't leave.
